text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 104,325 to 91,489 despite almost no trading, so I'll review my position sizes even when I don't plan to trade.","Three small monthly gains didn't prevent a 3.4% drop in period 10, so I won't treat a brief rebound as proof that the decline is over.","I sold 100 shares of Stock A at 56% below my average cost, which reminded me to decide whether a stock is worth holding at today's price rather than waiting to break even."]}
